paragraphs: Rav Chaga, in Rav Nachman’s time, son-in-law of Rav Adda bar Ahavah. In my opinion he encountered a corrupt reading, for it was Rav Chana the son-in-law (see his entry). Rav Nachman said,“Chaga recited”: Arakhin 7a.
